figurative_meaning_en: to assign responsibility or a task
example_sentences_in_bangla: বস তার কর্মচারীকে একটি নতুন প্রকল্পের কাজ দিয়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: The boss assigned a new project to his employee.
The mother gave her son household chores.
note: This idiom is commonly used in professional and domestic contexts to indicate delegating tasks.
